# v2026.10.26

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.26.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.26.md).

This release covers **8 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- A job board, invoicing screens and a sidebar shell, with a theme per account. ([#69](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/69))
- Each job links to its customer and its Xero invoice from Flow's own copies. ([#73](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/73))
- Every theme meets WCAG AA contrast, and CI checks it. ([#70](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/70))

## Changes

- Job board, invoicing screens and API, sidebar shell, theme per account. ([#69](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/69))
- Classic Integrations catalogue and detail page with brand logos. ([#71](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/71))
- Link each job to its customer and its Xero invoice from Flow's own copies. ([#73](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/73))
- Settings rows with a name, one short line and the control on the right. ([#80](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/80))

## Fixes

- Make every theme readable (WCAG AA), with a CI contrast check. ([#70](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/70))
- Clerk account window follows the theme and mode, with a clear gear icon. ([#74](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/74))
